scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.review:engine:up: npm run review:engine:setup && docker compose -f services/freeframe/docker-compose.dev.yml -f config/freeframe.compose.yml up -d postgres redis minio minio-init api worker web
scripts.review:engine:build: npm run review:engine:setup && docker compose -f services/freeframe/docker-compose.dev.yml -f config/freeframe.compose.yml up -d --build postgres redis minio minio-init api worker web
scripts.review:engine:logs: docker compose -f services/freeframe/docker-compose.dev.yml -f config/freeframe.compose.yml logs -f api worker web
